name: Rickey Rat CHAPTER 3
desc:
Credit to anart1996 and the radiance team for providing, 'The Face' and their fans for providing renders.

STORY: As previously seen in Chapter 1 and 2, you are visiting the clubhouse on a field trip. However, things start to take a very dark turn.

It's back and better than ever. Experience Chapter 3 of the internet breaking, world blowing up, web crashing game, Rickey Rat. The most disturbing chapter arrives, will you beat it?

⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️
WARNING, READ BEFORE PLAYING!!!: This game contains disturbing images, flashing lights, sudden loud noises, and jumpscares. PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK!
⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

CONTROLS:

MOUSE LOCK SWITCH:
PC - CTRL

Enemy Lock On:
PC - E
XBOX - Y

Dodging:
PC - F 
XBOX - B

Sprinting (hold):
PC - Shift
XBOX - LT
